frente: {{c1::Spironolactone}} improves survival in HFrEF by blocking the {{c2::mineralocorticoid (aldosterone)}} receptor.
extra: Aldosterone promotes Na<sup>+</sup> retention and myocardial fibrosis; receptor blockade reduces remodeling. Hyperkalemia follows because principal-cell K<sup>+</sup> secretion falls.

frente: Which heart sound is produced by blood striking a stiff, noncompliant left ventricle during atrial contraction?
extra: Atrial systole pushes blood into a ventricle with reduced compliance (e.g., LV hypertrophy), producing a late-diastolic sound just before S1.
fonte: Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology, 14th ed.

frente: A diuretic that inhibits the Na<sup>+</sup>/K<sup>+</sup>/2Cl<sup>−</sup> cotransporter acts on which nephron segment?
verso: Thick ascending limb of the loop of Henle
extra: Blocking NKCC2 abolishes the lumen-positive potential that drives paracellular Ca<sup>2+</sup> and Mg<sup>2+</sup> reabsorption, so loop diuretics cause hypocalcemia and hypomagnesemia.
nota_pt: Furosemida é o representante mais usado no Brasil.

frente: In emphysema, the FEV<sub>1</sub>/FVC ratio is {{c1::decreased}} and total lung capacity is {{c2::increased}}.
extra: Loss of elastic recoil causes airway collapse on expiration (obstruction) and air trapping, which raises TLC and residual volume.
fonte: West's Respiratory Physiology: The Essentials, 11th ed.

frente: Which enzyme deficiency causes episodic hemolysis with Heinz bodies after exposure to oxidant drugs?
extra: Without G6PD, red cells cannot generate NADPH to keep glutathione reduced, so oxidized hemoglobin precipitates as Heinz bodies and splenic macrophages create bite cells.
nota_pt: X-linked recessive; cuidado com primaquina, dapsona e sulfas.
fonte: Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th ed.

frente: Bruton agammaglobulinemia is caused by a defect in {{c1::BTK (Bruton tyrosine kinase)}}, which blocks {{c2::B-cell}} maturation.
extra: Without BTK signaling, pre-B cells do not mature, so all immunoglobulin classes are low and recurrent bacterial infections begin after maternal IgG wanes (about 6 months).
fonte: Abbas Cellular and Molecular Immunology, 10th ed.

frente: A lesion of which structure causes contralateral hemiballismus?
extra: The subthalamic nucleus drives the internal globus pallidus, which inhibits the thalamus. Losing that drive disinhibits thalamocortical output and produces flinging movements on the opposite side.
fonte: Kandel Principles of Neural Science, 6th ed.

frente: Classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia is most often due to {{c1::21-hydroxylase}} deficiency, which raises serum {{c2::17-hydroxyprogesterone}}.
extra: The block diverts precursors toward androgen synthesis while cortisol and aldosterone fall; low cortisol removes feedback, so ACTH rises and the adrenals enlarge.
nota_pt: Rastreado no teste do pezinho ampliado em vários estados.

frente: Biopsy of the small bowel shows villous atrophy, crypt hyperplasia and intraepithelial lymphocytes. Most likely diagnosis?
extra: Gliadin peptides deamidated by tissue transglutaminase bind HLA-DQ2/DQ8 and trigger a T-cell response that flattens the villi, most severely in the distal duodenum.
fonte: Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th ed.

frente: Marfan syndrome results from mutations in {{c1::FBN1 (fibrillin-1)}} with {{c2::autosomal dominant}} inheritance.
extra: Defective fibrillin weakens elastic fibers and releases excess TGF-β signaling, explaining aortic root dilation, lens subluxation and tall stature.
fonte: Thompson & Thompson Genetics in Medicine, 8th ed.

frente: Lowering the cutoff of a screening test so that more people test positive increases which property?
extra: More true positives are captured (fewer false negatives), at the cost of more false positives, so specificity and positive predictive value fall.

frente: Which organism produces the exfoliative toxin that cleaves desmoglein-1 in staphylococcal scalded skin syndrome?
extra: Exfoliative toxin is a serine protease that splits desmoglein-1 in the stratum granulosum, so the mucosa is spared (unlike toxic epidermal necrolysis).
